name: Descend through the weather
look: The first screen sinks through a cloud deck onto the place below: a full-bleed photograph from above the weather stands behind a flat band of the page's ground across the foot, which carries the name, one line and the action; two layers of cloud rise at different speeds and the band leaves as the cloud reaches it; a wall of mist fills the frame for a breath while one short line rises through it; then the frame clears from the bottom, under a ceiling of cloud, onto the second photograph, where a two-line statement rises on a band at the foot. The cloud is drawn once from layered noise in the page's own mist tint. No word sits straight on a photograph.
reduced: The picture from above, the name, the line and the action, then the statement and the picture from below.

needs.pictures: two photographs of the client's own site or world, one from above the cloud or high up (a launch site, a test range, a data centre on its plain, a game's world from above), one from below with a calm lower half
needs.words: a name of one word, one sentence of 8-14 words, a line of 3-7 words for the cloud, a statement of two short lines

never: a brief with no high and low pictures of its own site; a software page whose product is a screen (the hero shows the product); a local-business or place page; stock cloud photographs pasted in. Never the page's hero: its rest composition is two screens tall (restH 2), so on a phone, under reduced motion and without script the hero would be two screens; it comes below the hero, in a statement slot.
